comments.body:
In a fedora-tech message, Aaron included a link to a page that documents how to setup a Camel workflow that can be deployed in an OSGI container, or run from the command line, including building a JAR file with all dependencies included: http://kevinboone.net/mavencameltest.html

This seems like a good strategy to follow to make it easy to run the workflow for developers and users who want to try it out, but also make it easy to deploy in a production setting.

An initial PR for this is here: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-camel-toolbox/pull/1

Andrew Woods Can you review that PR so that Former user can take things from here?
fcrepo-camel-toolbox PR-1 has been merged into the master branch.
Back to you, Former user.
The work on this ticket shifted to FCREPO-1444 Closed , so I'm going to resolve this ticket.
